data.name: Khirzah
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Khirzah means 'Divine gift' or 'God's present'. This name is mentioned in the Quran, where it refers to the Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) servant, Azar, who was a righteous and pious man. He was granted a son, Prophet Ishmael (AS), as a divine gift from Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's blessings and mercy.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Khirzah have strong creativity, self-expression, and artistic abilities. They are often empathetic, sensitive, and compassionate individuals. They possess a strong desire for self-realization and seek to understand the deeper meaning of life.

in_urdu.name: خیرہ

in_hindi.name: ख़ैराह
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैराह का अर्थ है सुंदर या चयनित
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम ख़ैराह अरबी से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है सुंदर या चयनित। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष महत्व रखता है और इसकी सुंदर अर्थों की वजह से अक्सर चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: خیرزه
in_pashto.meaning: خیرزه معنی یي ښکل یا ټاکل شوې
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خیرزه نوم په پښتو کې ښکل یا ټاکل شوې معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري او په سیمه کې یې ځانګړی اهمیت دی.

in_english.name: Khirzah
in_english.meaning: Beautiful or chosen one, signifying elegance and divine selection
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khirzah originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'khayr' meaning good or beautiful. It signifies a person who is considered beautiful or chosen by God. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting qualities of elegance, piety, and divine favor. Historically, names like Khirzah were chosen for their meaningful connections to Quranic values and Arabic linguistic heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khirzah holds a significant cultural importance in Islamic history, as it highlights the concept of God's infinite mercy and generosity, as manifested in the form of a child as a gift. The story of Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) servant Azar and his son Prophet Ishmael (AS) demonstrates the importance of patience, perseverance, and trust in Allah, despite the odds. In Islamic cultures, the name Khirzah is often given to children as a reminder of the special gift of life and the Divine Providence that brings it about.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Khirzah carries deep spiritual significance as it challenges us to reflect on the blessings that Allah bestows upon us daily, sometimes in the most unexpected ways. It serves as a reminder of the infinite mercy and kindness of Allah, who grants us His love and guidance through various forms, such as through our family, friends, and even our trials and challenges. Khirzah also calls us to cultivate gratitude and contentment for what we have been given, and to be aware of the importance of nurturing and cherishing the gifts that Allah has bestowed upon us, just as Prophet Ishmael (AS) was cherished and nurtured by his father Azar, despite his advanced age. Ultimately, the name Khirzah encourages us to develop a deep sense of trust and reliance on Allah, who is the ultimate giver and sustainer of all things.
